features.text: PRECISION OFFLOADING CONTROL: Dial-adjustable hinge allows personalized pressure relief for unicompartmental osteoarthritis.
LIGHTWEIGHT DESIGN: Weighs under 14 oz for effortless daily wear without fatigue.
TRITECH FABRIC CONSTRUCTION: Combines compression, flexibility, and breathability for lasting comfort.
FRONT CLOSURE SYSTEM: Simplifies application and removal while ensuring consistent fit.
DUAL-COMPARTMENT STABILIZATION: Provides medial support for targeted knee unloading and mobility.
FSA HSA ELIGIBLE: Use your Flexible Spending or Health Savings Account for this purchase.
PERFECT FIT GUARANTEE: Free virtual fitting and adjustment session with our U.S.-based specialists.
